title: Prime-ideal criterion for geometric integrality of a hypersurface fibre
statement: Let S be an affine scheme, n a natural number, A = Gamma(S, top), and P in A[t_1,...,t_n] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring]. Let H = Spec(A[t]/(P)) [def-weil-affine-spectrum] with its coefficient morphism g to S. For s in S the fibre [def-pc-scheme-fibre] is both geometrically irreducible and geometrically reduced [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] if and only if, for every field K and ring map phi: kappa(s) -> K, the principal ideal generated by the image of P under phi composed with global evaluation at s is prime in K[t]. Prime includes properness. Neither S integral nor P nonzero is assumed.

source.place: Tags 01JQ and 05DY; affine base change and geometric integrality

proof.text: Paste the two fibre pullbacks. Using the canonical affine isomorphism S -> Spec A and fromSpecResidueField composed with toSpecGamma = Spec of global evaluation, identify the resulting pullback with Spec of (A[t]/(P)) tensor_A K by pullbackSpecIso. Commute the tensor factors, apply tensorQuotientEquiv, and use polynomial scalar extension to identify this ring with K[t]/(P_K). Ideal.map_span and the tensor polynomial formula identify the extended ideal with the principal ideal of P_K.

Transport integrality along the constructed spectrum isomorphism. affine_isIntegral_iff and Ideal.Quotient.isDomain_iff_prime identify it with primality. Geometric integrality is the conjunction of geometric reducedness and geometric irreducibility. Every map Spec K -> Spec kappa(s) is Spec of a ring map by Spec.map_surjective; hence quantifying the pointwise equivalence gives the result. All of these steps are proved in Lean from Mathlib, with no sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem hypersurface_geometric_fibre_prime_criterion
    {S : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S]
    (n : ℕ) (P : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤)) (s : S) :
    let H := Spec (.of (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(S, ⊤) ⧸ Ideal.span {P}))
    let g : H ⟶ S := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      ((Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {P})).comp MvPolynomial.C)) ≫ S.isoSpec.inv
    (GeometricallyIrreducible (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s) ∧
      GeometricallyReduced (g.fiberToSpecResidueField s)) ↔
      ∀ (K : Type u) [Field K] (φ : S.residueField s →+* K),
        (Ideal.span {MvPolynomial.map (φ.comp (S.Γevaluation s).hom) P}).IsPrime
